preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v, _ in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'B', 'R'} for _, _, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge is initially colored either 'B' (blue) or 'R' (red).

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value.split()) == int(return_value.split()[0]) + 1 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in return_value.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a sequence of integers where the first integer k is the number of moves, followed by k integers representing the vertices to be flipped.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(c == return_value.split()[1] for _, _, c in edges_after_moves)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, all edges will have the same color after the specified moves.
